rules.selection: Prefer NSE for the required observation when acquisition and reuse are usable. The fallbacks below are explicit choices, not claims that NSE publishes no macro data.
rules.missing: Blocked requirements return null/unavailable with their reason_code. No sample values, synthetic substitutions, guessed dates or automatic source switching.
rules.release_discovery: Concrete release URLs below are verified starting points, not permanent latest URLs. Discover newer releases from official indexes; validate title, period and revision before replacing a source URL.
rules.history: Retrieve and validate additional history in M3.5. A reachable release does not establish the entire five-period window or a previous-period comparison.
rules.freshness: Collector polling and stale thresholds are pending M3.6; preserve source observation precision, publication time when known, and separate retrieval/check times.
rules.release_gate: Recheck terms and hosted access before enabling a route. No publisher has been contacted and no subscription or permission has been obtained.

world_bank.constraint: CC BY 4.0 with World Bank additional terms; credit WDI and original data providers, retain the terms link, identify transformations and imply no endorsement.

pib.constraint: Accurate attributed reproduction; third-party material is excluded. Collect the issuing ministry's release text/tables, not embedded third-party images.

nse_research.constraint: The report's specific disclaimer requires NSE notification and acknowledgement for extracts. This has not been satisfied; general educational-use wording does not establish this route's clearance.

nse_market.constraint: Successful public JSON access does not establish scheduled feed and redistribution rights; relevant usage agreement/permission remains unresolved.

bse_market.constraint: Published terms restrict automated access and redistribution. No quote feed has been selected or licensed.

gstn.constraint: Official report is accessible and readable; reuse conditions for this GSTN-hosted release are not verified. GST Council's separate policy must not be assumed to cover this host.

cga.constraint: Published policy contains conflicting permission wording and references an unrelated institution. Use the verified Ministry of Finance release on PIB instead.

imf.constraint: Search-accessible policy describes limited noncommercial use and separate systematic/commercial reuse conditions; native policy request returned 403. Do not treat the public Data Mapper API as unrestricted.

gazette.constraint: Local TLS certificate-chain validation failed, including with the system CA store. Never disable certificate verification to collect it.

nse_pulse.limits: Monthly research publication; observation periods lag publication. Anchors below use one-based PDF pages and must be rediscovered by title/headers, not fixed page positions.

nse_budget.limits: Budget report: actuals, RE and BE are distinct. Chart labels are not an approved numeric extraction method.

nse_indices.limits: timestamp is an envelope field; validate it against the quote session. Browser-oriented, undocumented endpoint: no availability SLA, verified delay or scheduled collection entitlement.

nse_market_status.limits: Use Capital Market only; do not substitute GIFT futures or another segment. Timestamp timezone/session must be validated with the index response.

world_bank_gdp.limits: Source unit field is blank: verify indicator metadata, do not infer from it. Dataset lastupdated is not the observation publication date. Decimal-preserving parsing and bounded pagination belong to M3.4.

mospi_gdp_pib.locator: Annual GDP Estimates and Growth Rates; real GDP at constant 2022-23 prices, not nominal GDP or Q4 growth.
mospi_gdp_pib.limits: June 2026 PE release includes revisions. The new base does not establish a five-year comparable back series. Release images are not a text-table feed.

commerce_trade_pib.locator: Table 1, Merchandise rows, September 2026 and September 2025 columns, US$ Billion.
commerce_trade_pib.limits: Exclude services estimates and cumulative Table 2. Validate merged headers; total-trade balance is not merchandise balance.

mospi_cpi_pib.locator: All-India Combined headline CPI year-on-year inflation; identify Combined column, not rural, urban, CPI index level or food inflation.
mospi_cpi_pib.limits: Preserve provisional/final distinction. Old-base histories cannot be spliced into base 2024 without a verified bridge.

gstn_gross.locator: First page, A.3 Total Gross GST Revenue, Yearly columns ending March 2025 and March 2026; D.1 Cess is separate.
gstn_gross.limits: Provisional figures, excluding separately reported compensation cess. Reuse and a comparable longer history remain unresolved; old gross-including-cess totals are incompatible.

cga_accounts.locator: Actuals column only: Revenue Expenditure, Capital Expenditure and Total Expenditure.
cga_accounts.limits: Unaudited provisional April-to-August cumulative actuals; BE amounts and COPPY percentages are different measures. Published web policy is ambiguous.

finance_accounts_pib.locator: Total Expenditure paragraph; Revenue Account and Capital Account amounts, in crore.
finance_accounts_pib.limits: Cumulative provisional actuals, not monthly flows. Prior-year amounts and additional history require separate validated releases.

imf_debt.limits: Country URL returned other countries too; explicitly select IND. Response mixes historical and future years without per-value actual/estimate flags. Actual cutoff, Indian reporting basis and reuse scope need verification.

inflation_target_gazette.limits: Primary notification and exact effective interval have not been read successfully. The speech does not replace that interval check; no static target value is embedded here.

bse_sensex.limits: The HTML shell is not quote data. No usable, permitted timestamped quote response has been verified; do not substitute BSE company stock.

gdp_growth_india.locator: PDF p321 annual macro snapshot, GDP (Constant) Growth row
gdp_growth_india.selection_reason: Research extract notice/reuse gate unresolved; use MoSPI release via PIB.

gdp_growth_world.selection_reason: WDI WLD annual aggregate/history not verified in inspected NSE material; use World Bank, without claiming NSE-wide absence.

debt_to_gdp.selection_reason: Central/state liabilities do not establish a comparable general-government gross debt series; IMF alternative remains gated.

trade.locator: PDF p84 quarterly BoP; p81 monthly growth rates
trade.selection_reason: Monthly USD merchandise amounts not verified in inspected NSE tables; use Commerce release via PIB.

gst_collection.selection_reason: Research reuse and matching cess coverage unresolved; GSTN alternative is also gated.

inflation_india.selection_reason: Research reuse unresolved; use current MoSPI release via PIB.

rbi_target.selection_reason: No complete legal validity interval verified; primary notification retrieval blocked.

government_expenditure.selection_reason: Research reuse unresolved; use Finance/CGA actuals release via PIB, keeping cumulative periods.

nifty_bank.selection_reason: Preferred NSE route verified; feed usage and cadence gates remain.

nifty_it.selection_reason: Preferred NSE route verified; feed usage and cadence gates remain.

sensex.selection_reason: Required BSE index quote not verified at NSE; BSE route remains permission-gated.

gdp_growth_india.definition: Annual real GDP growth, constant 2022-23 prices, India April-March FY; preserve PE/FRE and release vintage.
gdp_growth_india.comparison: Previous comparable FY growth, delta in percentage points; no India-World difference across unlike periods.
gdp_growth_india.history: Latest and prior FY growth verified in release text; longer comparable back series pending. Label FY separately from World CY in the M4 projection.

gdp_growth_world.definition: WDI NY.GDP.MKTP.KD.ZG, WLD aggregate annual real GDP growth; preserve source year labels and metadata vintage.
gdp_growth_world.comparison: Previous available consecutive year growth, delta in percentage points; never invent a missing reference year.
gdp_growth_world.history: Ten annual non-null observations verified; display target is latest five validated years. Preserve year precision, no invented day.

debt_to_gdp_india.definition: General-government gross debt as a share of GDP, India; not central debt, external debt or private debt.
debt_to_gdp_india.unblock: Verify Indian reporting-year basis, last actual year and intended reuse scope before selecting observations. No forecast-as-actual substitution.

imports.definition: Reported monthly merchandise imports at current USD billions; exclude services and cumulative FY totals.
imports.comparison: Same month of previous year, percentage change from comparable monetary amounts; not percentage points.
imports.history: September 2026 and prior-year month verified. Additional monthly releases must be discovered and validated in M3.5.

exports.definition: Reported monthly merchandise exports at current USD billions; same scope and period as imports.
exports.comparison: Same month of previous year, percentage change from comparable monetary amounts; not percentage points.
exports.history: Same verified monthly coverage as imports; revisions must use one release vintage for each paired point.

trade_balance.definition: Merchandise exports minus imports; a deficit is negative. Not the release's goods-plus-services balance.
trade_balance.gate: M3.5: decimal arithmetic, matched month/unit/coverage/vintage, retain both inputs; any missing input gives null.

gst_total.definition: Full April-March FY, reported Total Gross GST Revenue excluding separately reported compensation cess; provisional, before refunds.
gst_total.unblock: Verify reuse or a compatible official republished table; retain gross/net/cess distinctions and validate reporting window. No rounded infographic or growth-rate replacement.

gst_monthly_average.definition: Monthly mean over the same complete April-March FY as gst_total, excluding compensation cess.
gst_monthly_average.gate: M3.5: only divide an explicitly verified complete twelve-month total; never apply to a partial FY or mixed cess coverage.
gst_monthly_average.unblock: Clear total's source/window gate and validate the annual-to-monthly transform.

cpi_yoy.definition: All-India Combined headline CPI YoY, base 2024=100, reported monthly; preserve provisional/final status.
cpi_yoy.comparison: Previous month reported YoY rate, delta in percentage points, only if same base and comparable vintage.
cpi_yoy.history: Current release and its revised prior month; remaining comparable monthly history is M3.5 work. Do not average monthly YoY rates into an annual CPI measure.

rbi_target.definition: Applicable notified CPI inflation target and effective interval; policy reference, not an observed inflation rate or repo rate.
rbi_target.unblock: Read the primary notification with valid TLS; verify exact valid_from/valid_to and target. Historical targets need their own valid intervals; no PNG constant.

expenditure_capital.definition: Union government provisional actual capital-account expenditure, April through the named month; not BE or effective capital expenditure.
expenditure_capital.comparison: Same cutoff of prior FY using actual amounts; omit until acquired. COPPY utilisation percentages are not prior-year amounts.
expenditure_capital.history: August 2026 cutoff verified; successive cumulative snapshots are not summed or presented as monthly flows.

expenditure_revenue.definition: Published Union revenue-account expenditure, same provisional actual period as capital; not revenue receipts.
expenditure_revenue.comparison: No separate summary; any later comparison needs matched fiscal cutoffs and actuals.
expenditure_revenue.history: Same validated releases as capital; do not derive a complementary stack value to hide a missing source field.

expenditure_total.definition: Published Union total expenditure, same provisional actual period as revenue and capital; reconcile all three on source precision.
expenditure_total.comparison: Same cutoff of prior FY using actual amounts, percentage growth only after comparability verification.
expenditure_total.history: Supplied total for each cumulative cutoff, no frontend calculation and no annual relabelling.

nifty_bank.definition: NIFTY BANK price index; last, point change and percent change against previous official close, with an Asia/Kolkata quote/session timestamp.
nifty_bank.unblock: Establish permitted feed usage, delay, refresh cadence and session/timestamp handling; remain unavailable with unknown cadence until then.

nifty_it.definition: NIFTY IT price index, same previous-close and timezone rules as NIFTY BANK; not a stock, total-return index or futures quote.
nifty_it.unblock: Clear the NSE feed usage/cadence gate and validate quote/session alignment before enabling.

sensex.definition: BSE SENSEX price index, previous official close, quote timestamp and session; not NSE-listed BSE company stock.
sensex.unblock: Verify a permitted timestamped BSE index feed; app-shell HTTP 200 is insufficient.

debt_india_us_comparison.definition: Design does not establish US ratio versus India-US gap. Keep the existing unbound summary slot unavailable.
debt_india_us_comparison.unblock: Approve the statistic, align geography coverage/periods/vintage and update canonical bindings before adding a series.
